articles.summary: LYNNWOOD, Wash., May 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zumiez Inc. (NASDAQ: ZUMZ) today announced it will report fiscal 2026 first quarter results on Thursday, June 4, 2026, following the closing of regular stock market trading hours. The Company will hold a conference call that day at 5:00 p.m.
articles.title: Zumiez Inc. to Report Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results
